content:
This is an abstraction from Bernstein's projector for compact smooth representations at a fix level. The starting point of this PR is that Bernstein's original argument needs some annoying countability condition and does not generalize to Q^bar-coeff directly due to the absence of the separation lemma. To the best of my knowledge, the separation lemma for the group algebra Q^bar[G] is an open problem and there are counterexamples for general reduced countable dimensional Q^bar-algebra. It's surely well-known to experts that Bernstein's statement about the projector is still true over Q^bar, but it has not been documented in literature. Hence our formalizaiton is a mathematically nontrivial exercise when we apply these materials to the rational Hecke algebra of p-adic reductive groups whose centeral reducedness can be proved directly, avoiding the rational separation lemma in the unimodular case.

How? In this PR we prove that the Bernstein's projector (i.e. IsTraceRepresentative) f for some simple module V is non-zero and if f ^ 2 ≠ 0 then f acts nontrivially on V. For the rational Hecke algebra, the symmetric nondegenerate structure is established from my earlier Hecke PR, i.e. coeff_1 and unimodular API, and f ^ 2 can be proved to be non-zero by a positivity argument, i.e. flatness, structureConst API.
